mapper.select: SELECT '0' AS chk , t1.CORP_GR AS corp_gr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.JM_CD AS yj_cd , NVL(ya.JM_NM, jj.JJ_NM) AS xx_yj_cd , NVL(ya.JM_NM, jj.JJ_NM) AS jm_nm , ya.BLBG_TCKR AS srs_cd , t1.JONGA AS syt0lp_jonga , t1.SHORT_PRICE AS short_price , t1.GIJUN_PRICE AS gijun_price , t1.D30_VOLATILITY AS d30_volatility , t1.G30_VOLATILITY AS g30_volatility , t1.MA50 AS ma50 , t1.MA200 AS ma200 , t1.OVRS_EXCG_CD AS ovrs_excg_cd , NVL(pct.jonga_chg_pct, tg.jonga_chg_pct) AS jonga_chg_pct , NVL(pct.chg_pct_5d, tg.chg_pct_5d) AS chg_pct_5d , NVL(pct.chg_pct_10d, tg.chg_pct_10d) AS chg_pct_10d , NVL(pct.chg_pct_15d, tg.chg_pct_15d) AS chg_pct_15d , NVL(pct.chg_pct_20d, tg.chg_pct_20d) AS chg_pct_20d , hl.HIGH_VALUE AS high_value , TO_CHAR(hl.HIGH_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS high_ymd , hl.LOW_VALUE AS low_value , TO_CHAR(hl.LOW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS low_ymd , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USPM ta WHERE ta.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ta.YMD = t1.YMD AND ta.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS tuja_yn FROM USPM_DD t1 LEFT JOIN SYM0YA ya ON ya.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ya.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD LEFT JOIN SJM0JJ jj ON jj.KOSCOM_CD = t1.JM_CD AND jj.DANC_GB IN ('A','C') LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT JM_CD , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_1) / NULLIF(PREV_1,0) * 100,2) AS JONGA_CHG_PCT , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_5) / NULLIF(PREV_5,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_5D , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_10) / NULLIF(PREV_10,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_10D , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_15) / NULLIF(PREV_15,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_15D , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_20) / NULLIF(PREV_20,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_20D FROM ( SELECT lp.YMD , lp.JM_CD , lp.JONGA , LAG(lp.JONGA,1) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.JM_CD ORDER BY lp.YMD) AS PREV_1 , LAG(lp.JONGA,5) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.JM_CD ORDER BY lp.YMD) AS PREV_5 , LAG(lp.JONGA,10) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.JM_CD ORDER BY lp.YMD) AS PREV_10 , LAG(lp.JONGA,15) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.JM_CD ORDER BY lp.YMD) AS PREV_15 , LAG(lp.JONGA,20) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.JM_CD ORDER BY lp.YMD) AS PREV_20 FROM SYT0LP lp WHERE lp.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND lp.YMD BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),-3) AND TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND lp.JM_CD IN ( SELECT JM_CD FROM USPM_DD g1 WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND YMD = TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SZX0HL d8 WHERE d8.NATION_CD = 'US' AND d8.HOLI_YMD = lp.YMD ) ) p1 WHERE YMD = TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) pct ON pct.jm_cd = t1.JM_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT KOSCOM_CD AS jm_cd , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_1) / NULLIF(PREV_1,0) * 100,2) AS JONGA_CHG_PCT , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_5) / NULLIF(PREV_5,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_5D , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_10) / NULLIF(PREV_10,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_10D , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_15) / NULLIF(PREV_15,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_15D , ROUND((JONGA - PREV_20) / NULLIF(PREV_20,0) * 100,2) AS CHG_PCT_20D FROM ( SELECT tg.YMD , tg.KOSCOM_CD , tg.CLOSE AS jonga , LAG(tg.CLOSE,1) OVER (PARTITION BY tg.KOSCOM_CD ORDER BY tg.YMD) AS PREV_1 , LAG(tg.CLOSE,5) OVER (PARTITION BY tg.KOSCOM_CD ORDER BY tg.YMD) AS PREV_5 , LAG(tg.CLOSE,10) OVER (PARTITION BY tg.KOSCOM_CD ORDER BY tg.YMD) AS PREV_10 , LAG(tg.CLOSE,15) OVER (PARTITION BY tg.KOSCOM_CD ORDER BY tg.YMD) AS PREV_15 , LAG(tg.CLOSE,20) OVER (PARTITION BY tg.KOSCOM_CD ORDER BY tg.YMD) AS PREV_20 FROM SJT1TG tg WHERE tg.YMD BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),-3) AND TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND tg.KOSCOM_CD IN ( SELECT JM_CD FROM USPM_DD g1 WHERE CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND YMD = TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SZX0HL d8 WHERE d8.NATION_CD = 'KR' AND d8.HOLI_YMD = tg.YMD ) ) p1 WHERE YMD = F_OPEN_YMD(TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),'-') ) tg ON tg.jm_cd = t1.JM_CD , TABLE(F_HIGH_LOW (#{corpGr}, TO_DATE(#{fymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) hl WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(#{tymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ((#{tt} BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND ya.JM_CD IS NOT NULL) OR (#{tt} NOT BETWEEN '1' AND '9' AND jj.KOSCOM_CD IS NOT NULL)) AND hl.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD ORDER BY ya.JM_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USPM ( CORP_GR, YMD, FUND_CD, PORT_NUM, JM_CD, COL, OVRS_EXCG_CD ) VALUES ( #{corpGr}, TO_DATE(#{ymd}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{fundCd}, #{portNum}, #{jmCd}, #{col}, #{ovrsExcgCd} )
